intro: Messenger to Westfall is a diplomatic errand that carries Gryan Stoutmantle's sober reply from Sentinel Hill back to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire. Solomon, beleaguered by local threats in Redridge, sought military reinforcement from the People's Militia, only to learn that Westfall is equally forsaken by the crown.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read. But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia. If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.
Take this response to your master in Redridge, adventurer. And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon? Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I do say, this is not good at all. I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire. What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people? Bah, I should not ponder aloud.
Here, messenger. Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township. I might call upon you again.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
